steps.label: RTO
steps.sub: how long can it stay down before that's unacceptable

steps.label: RPO
steps.sub: how much data loss, in time, is acceptable on restore

steps.label: Both
steps.sub: business decisions first — technical answers second

code:
Business:  "We can lose at most 1 hour of order data."
           -> RPO = 1 hour

Engineer:  Backups must run at least every 60 minutes.
           A nightly-only schedule does NOT meet this RPO.
caption: An RPO of 1 hour means hourly backups, minimum — not "roughly once an hour."

steps.label: Wrong order
steps.sub: pick a nightly backup, call it "the strategy"

steps.label: Right order
steps.sub: set RTO/RPO, then build the schedule that satisfies them

steps.label: RTO includes
steps.sub: detection time, not just the restore itself
